typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		medicaidNo as string,
		lastName as string,
		firstName as string,
		midInit as string,
		sex as string,
		birthDate as timestamp,
		homeAddrLine1 as string,
		homeAddrLine2 as string,
		homeCity as string,
		homeState as string,
		homeZip5 as string,
		homeZip4 as string,
		homePhone as string,
		publicationDTM as timestamp,
		groupKey as string,
		memberCK as string,
		LangCode as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT	distinct ml.memberKey as memberCK  	,COALESCE(t2.AGP_GROUP_KEY,m.groupKey) as groupKey 	,m.medicaidNo 	,m.lastName 	,m.firstName 	,m.midInit 	,m.sex 	,m.birthDate 	,m.homeAddrLine1 	,m.homeAddrLine2 	,m.homeCity 	,m.homeState 	,LEFT(m.homeZip,5) homeZip5 	,RIGHT(m.homeZip,4) homeZip4 	,m.homePhone 	,m.publicationDTM 	,m.LangCode FROM ##PDS_WGS_GROUP_KEYS t inner join [APP_RTDI].[DI_Stage_MemberHeader] m with (nolock) on t.AGP_GROUP_KEY = m.groupKey or t.OLD_GROUP_KEY = m.groupKey inner join (select memberCK, MAX(publicationDTM) maxPubDate 	 from [APP_RTDI].[DI_Stage_MemberHeader] m2 with (nolock) 	group by memberCK) mmax 	on m.memberCK = mmax.memberCK 	and m.publicationDTM = mmax.maxPubDate 	and m.medicaidNo not like \'%NB%\' inner join APP_RTDI.DI_Consolidated_MemberList ml with (nolock) 	on m.memberCK = convert(varchar(50),ml.externalId) left outer join ##PDS_WGS_GROUP_KEYS t2 on m.groupKey = t2.OLD_GROUP_KEY WHERE m.publicationDTM > ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> CareAdvanceCMDMMembers
CareAdvanceCMDMMembers derive(medicaidNo = medicaidNo) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount1
PlaceHolderRowCount1 sink(input(
		DateOfBirth as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		HomePhoneNum as string,
		FirstName as string,
		GroupKey as string,
		McaidNumber as string,
		SourceUpdateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Gender as string,
		City as string,
		MiddleName as string,
		AddressLine2 as string,
		LanguageCode as string,
		AddressLine1 as string,
		State as string,
		MemberNumber as string,
		LastName as string,
		ZipCode4 as string,
		ZipCode5 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DateOfBirth = birthDate,
		HomePhoneNum = homePhone,
		FirstName = firstName,
		GroupKey = groupKey,
		McaidNumber = medicaidNo,
		SourceUpdateDate = publicationDTM,
		Gender = sex,
		City = homeCity,
		MiddleName = midInit,
		AddressLine2 = homeAddrLine2,
		LanguageCode = LangCode,
		AddressLine1 = homeAddrLine1,
		State = homeState,
		MemberNumber = memberCK,
		LastName = lastName,
		ZipCode4 = homeZip4,
		ZipCode5 = homeZip5)) ~> PDSCACMDMMemberStaging
